items.title: Sa'yo Lang Titibok
items.caption: Contemporary Filipino R&B and soul-pop love song sung in Tagalog. A smooth, breathy young male tenor, intimate and close to the microphone, gliding into a silky falsetto in the chorus, with stacked airy vocal harmonies and soft ad-libs. Mellow Rhodes electric piano chords, warm sub bass, a gentle clean electric guitar, slow laid-back R&B drums with finger snaps and crisp hi-hats, dreamy reverb. Tender, romantic, late at night, devoted to one girl. Modern, polished, warm production.
items.lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
Hindi ko alam kung paano nagsimula

Kahit saan, kahit kailan, pangako
Sa'yo lang titibok
Ang puso kong ito

[Verse 2]
Ang boses mo'y himig na paulit-ulit
Sa aking isip, kay sarap pakinggan
Kapag kasama ka, humihinto ang mundo
Ayoko nang matapos ang sandaling ito

Sa'yo lang, sa'yo lang ako
Kahit saan, kahit kailan, pangako
Sa'yo lang titibok
Ang puso kong ito

[Bridge]

Ayoko nang magising
Dito lang sa piling mo
Ang gusto kong marating

[Chorus]
Sa'yo lang, sa'yo lang ako
Kahit saan, kahit kailan, pangako
Sa'yo lang titibok
Ang puso kong ito

[Outro]
Sa'yo lang, sa'yo lang

items.title: Dahan-Dahan Lang
items.caption: Slow, sensual Filipino R&B slow jam sung in Tagalog. A soft, breathy young male tenor almost whispering the verses, rising into a delicate, aching falsetto in the chorus, with layered airy harmonies. Warm electric piano, deep sub bass, a muted clean guitar, very slow sparse drums with rim clicks and finger snaps, lush pads, long reverb tails. Intimate, hushed, two people awake together in the small hours. Modern, polished, warm production.

Sa gulo ng mundo, ikaw ang kapayapaan

items.title: Bituin sa Mata Mo
items.caption: Dreamy Filipino soul-pop ballad sung in Tagalog. A smooth young male tenor with a light, floating falsetto carrying most of the chorus, wide stacked harmonies and gentle vocal runs. Shimmering electric piano, soft synth pads, a clean chorus-effect guitar picking arpeggios, round bass, relaxed R&B drums with brushed hi-hats, spacious reverb. Starry, wide-eyed, in love with a girl under the night sky. Modern, polished, warm production.

items.title: Kape at Ulan
items.caption: Mellow acoustic Filipino R&B love song sung in Tagalog. A warm, breathy young male tenor singing softly, slipping into a tender falsetto at the ends of lines, with close two-part harmonies. Fingerpicked nylon-string acoustic guitar, soft Rhodes electric piano, warm upright-style bass, a gentle lo-fi drum loop with brushes and a soft shaker. Cozy, unhurried, a rainy morning at home with the girl he loves. Intimate, warm, close-miked production.

items.title: Sayaw sa Sala
items.caption: Groovy Filipino neo-soul and R&B love song sung in Tagalog. A smooth, playful young male tenor with an easy falsetto in the chorus, stacked harmonies answering the lead. A melodic, bouncing electric bass line up front, warm Rhodes electric piano with jazzy chords, clean funk guitar plucks, a relaxed head-nodding drum groove with a tight snare and handclaps, soft horn pads. Sweet, flirtatious, slow dancing with a girl in the living room. Modern, polished, warm production.

items.title: Kung Papayag Ka
items.caption: Heartfelt Filipino soul ballad sung in Tagalog, slow and swaying in six-eight time. A tender young male tenor, breathy and vulnerable in the verses, soaring into a pleading falsetto in the chorus, with gospel-tinged backing harmonies. Soft grand piano, warm electric piano, a swelling string section, round bass, gentle drums with brushes. Earnest, nervous, a young man finally confessing his love to a girl. Warm, polished, emotional production.
items.lyrics:

items.title: Sa Ngiti Mo
items.caption: Bright, easygoing Filipino R&B-pop love song sung in Tagalog. A smooth, smiling young male tenor with a light falsetto hook and playful ad-libs, stacked sunny harmonies. Bouncy Rhodes electric piano, a plucky clean guitar riff, warm melodic bass, a crisp mid-tempo drum groove with finger snaps and handclaps, soft synth bells. Lighthearted, sweet, helplessly charmed by a girl's smile. Modern, polished, warm production.

items.title: Uuwi Ako Sa'yo
items.caption: Moody late-night Filipino R&B love song sung in Tagalog. A low, breathy young male tenor in the verses, opening into a yearning falsetto in the chorus, with hazy layered harmonies and soft ad-libs. Deep sub bass, dark warm electric piano chords, a distant reverb-soaked guitar, slow sparse drums with fast ticking hi-hats and a soft snare, atmospheric pads. Longing, devoted, far from the girl he loves and coming home to her. Modern, polished, spacious production.
